title: Pay the actual finite DATA-decoupling operation and its pointer footprint
statement: First initiation remains off and the tracker target stays fixed. Scale every native C payload Hermitian edge and every held-target DATA-active program hop with its adjoint to zero; holding the target alone is not decoupling. Both coarse native and target-ready program predicates are termwise noncreating. On each coherent ket/bra source mask the nominal DATA propagator is identity outside its full owner/program-column union. Every bounded-body joint perturbation adds only a bounded footprint, INCLUDING the DATA column associated with a pointer-only fault. For the actual aligned positive retired input the per-leg weight is<=sigma_Gamma alpha_mem N+r_D beta_ctrl N+b beta_prog N+q_comb r; the original forest and nominal ramp use the SAME union and are counted once. Treat the strong finite ramp as nominal CPTP, propagate incoming error through the SAME real suffix first, and only then use the combined forward-Dyson tail. After both families are off, the required product detector background is earned.
